name: KromiumClient
description: Represents a client session in the engine. A client groups multiple browsers under a shared context (such as shared cookies, cache, proxy configuration, network request interceptors, and listeners).
whenToUse: Obtain via engine.createClient(config) to group browser instances with custom session interceptors, listeners, proxy rules, and download configurations.

properties.name: inFlightRequestCount
properties.description: The number of active, in-flight network requests across all browsers in this client.

properties.name: downloadListener
properties.description: Listener for tracking global download progress.

properties.name: downloadDirectory
properties.description: The default directory where downloads should be saved.

properties.name: onBeforeDownloadListener
properties.description: Optional interceptor to dynamically resolve the target path before a download begins. Return null to use default path, or return empty string "" to cancel.

properties.name: doNotTrack
properties.description: Whether to assert Do Not Track (DNT) and Global Privacy Control (Sec-GPC) headers on outbound requests.

properties.name: rememberPermissions
properties.description: Whether permission decisions (e.g. camera, microphone) should be cached for the lifetime of this client session.

properties.name: requestInterceptor
properties.description: Request interceptor for filtering or modifying outgoing HTTP/HTTPS requests.

properties.name: navigationInterceptor
properties.description: Interceptor for evaluating and potentially overriding top-level navigation.

properties.name: jsDialogListener
properties.description: Listener for JavaScript dialogs (alert, confirm, prompt).

properties.name: enableContextMenus
properties.description: Globally enables or disables native right-click context menus for this client. Defaults to true.

properties.name: contextMenuListener
properties.description: Listener for context menu events and custom menu construction.

properties.name: currentProxy
properties.description: The currently active proxy configuration for this client session, or null if no custom proxy has been set.

methods.name: createBrowser
methods.signature: fun createBrowser(url: String, config: KromiumClientConfig = KromiumClientConfig.default()): KromiumBrowser
methods.description: Creates a new browser instance managed by this client.

methods.name: createBrowser
methods.signature: fun createBrowser(url: String, framework: KromiumUiFramework): KromiumBrowser
methods.description: Creates a new browser instance managed by this client with an explicit UI framework.

methods.name: hasPendingRequests
methods.description: Whether there are any pending network requests active on this client.

methods.name: timeSinceLastRequestMs
methods.description: The number of milliseconds elapsed since the last network request completed.

methods.name: setContextMenu
methods.description: Configures the right-click context menu using a declarative builder block.

methods.name: updateProxy
methods.description: Dynamically updates the proxy settings for this client session.

methods.name: clearPermissionCache
methods.description: Clears all remembered permission decisions from the in-memory session cache.

methods.name: cancelDownload
methods.description: Cancels an active download by its ID.

methods.name: pauseDownload
methods.description: Pauses an active download by its ID.

methods.name: resumeDownload
methods.description: Resumes a paused download by its ID.

methods.name: isDownloadPaused
methods.description: Checks if a download is currently paused.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes the client and all associated browsers.
